allowed: execute Python standard-library models locally or in CI
reproduce code mechanisms without external network access
compare vulnerable and guarded state transitions
write immutable JSON and hash manifests
prohibited: connect to Redis or WebSocket servers
fuzz, enumerate, stress, or load test
claim Tradernet uses the simulated implementation
claim a server-side resource leak without internal observability

scenarios.invariant: The exact serialized identity added to membership is the identity removed during cleanup.
scenarios.vulnerable_model: SADD user_id followed by SREM ws_id leaves stale membership.
scenarios.guarded_model: Generation-scoped membership token is used symmetrically for add and remove.

scenarios.invariant: Closing one physical socket must not remove subscriptions owned by another live socket.
scenarios.guarded_model: Subscriptions are owned and cleaned by connection plus generation.

scenarios.invariant: Late cleanup from an old generation cannot mutate current generation state.
scenarios.vulnerable_model: Stale disconnect deletes whichever generation is current.
scenarios.guarded_model: Cleanup is limited to the exact generation that initiated it.

scenarios.invariant: Each intended socket receives one logical event exactly once.
scenarios.vulnerable_model: Immediate local send plus same-instance Pub/Sub echo produces two deliveries.
scenarios.guarded_model: Event ID deduplication makes publisher echo harmless.

scenarios.invariant: Mutation authorization requires exact non-production environment, exact allowlisted origin, sandbox account, explicit flag, bound confirmation, and unused nonce.
scenarios.vulnerable_model: No external call is modeled because the unsafe operation itself is outside authority.
scenarios.guarded_model: Production, origin confusion, non-sandbox account, missing flag, wrong confirmation, and nonce replay are refused.

scenarios.invariant: Cookie, Authorization, API key, SID, session, and token values never enter logs or evidence.
scenarios.vulnerable_model: Historical full-header and raw-session diagnostics are represented only by sentinel inputs.
scenarios.guarded_model: Sensitive headers and text patterns are redacted before serialization.

scenarios.invariant: External calls use explicit finite timeouts and report content is HTML-escaped.
scenarios.vulnerable_model: Only harmless sentinel content is supplied; no network call or script execution occurs.
scenarios.guarded_model: Fake transport records a five-second timeout and hostile HTML remains escaped text.

scenarios.invariant: Mocked, skipped, unavailable, and live outcomes retain distinct result classes.
scenarios.vulnerable_model: Broad success aggregation is represented as the rejected alternative.
scenarios.guarded_model: SIMULATED_PASS, NOT_RUN, UNAVAILABLE, and LIVE_PASS remain distinct.

non_claims: No Tradernet internal root cause is confirmed.
No server-side Redis or connection leak is confirmed.
No order-execution or financial impact is tested.
No production readiness conclusion is produced.
